units.source_text: 太君大为不快，对内大臣说：“我只有一个女儿，不幸短命而死，我很寂寞。

en.t: The grand lady was greatly displeased and said to the Inner Minister, "I had only one daughter, and she died young, leaving me very lonely.

units.source_text: 且喜来了这个孩子，在我如获至宝。

en.t: Then, happily, this child came to me, and I felt as though I had found a priceless treasure.

units.source_text: 实指望她朝夕在侧，慰我暮年呢。

en.t: I truly hoped she would stay by my side morning and evening and comfort me in my old age.

units.source_text: 却不料你不信任我，教我好伤心啊！”

en.t: But I never expected that you would not trust me. How deeply it hurts me!"

units.source_text: 内大臣心甚抱歉，连忙答道：“母亲息怒！

en.t: The Inner Minister felt deeply apologetic and quickly replied, "Mother, please calm your anger!

units.source_text: 儿子所不满者，就只是那一件事，却并非不信任母亲。

en.t: What I am dissatisfied with is only that one matter; it is certainly not that I distrust you, Mother.

units.source_text: 只因宫中那个女御，近来心绪不佳，现正乞假在家。

en.t: It is only because that lady-in-waiting at court has been in poor spirits lately and is now at home on leave.

units.source_text: 看她寂寞无聊，甚是可怜，为此想叫云居雁前去陪伴，以慰其心。

en.t: Seeing her lonely and listless, I feel very sorry for her, so I wanted to send Kumoi no Kari to keep her company and comfort her heart.
This was only meant to be temporary."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“云居雁蒙太君抚育，得以长大成人，此恩决不敢忘。”

en.t: He then added, "Kumoi no Kari was raised by Your Ladyship and grew to adulthood through your care; I would never dare forget that kindness."

units.source_text: 这内大臣脾气固执，凡事一经想定，即使多人劝阻，决不回心转意。

en.t: This Inner Minister was stubborn by nature; once he had made up his mind about something, even if many people tried to dissuade him, he would never change his view.

units.source_text: 因此太君很不高兴，叹道：“人心难测，令人忧恼。

en.t: For this reason the grand lady was very unhappy and sighed, "People's hearts are hard to fathom, and it is truly distressing.

units.source_text: 这两个孩子小小年纪，就心生隔膜，弃我如遗！

en.t: These two children are still so young, yet already they have grown estranged and cast me aside as if I were nothing!
As for children being young and ignorant, let that pass for the moment.

units.source_text: 大臣深明事理，怎么也会对我心怀怨恨，来夺取这个孩子呢？

en.t: But how can a minister who understands reason so well bear resentment toward me and come to take this child away?

units.source_text: 我看她在那边，不见得比我这里安全吧！”

en.t: To my eyes, she will not necessarily be any safer there than she is here with me!"
As she said this, she began to cry.
